title: IoT Concepts & Architecture Fill in the Blanks Quiz
description: Fill in the blanks practice questions covering IoT architecture, reference models, networking layers, protocols, and security.
heading: Concept of IoT & Architecture Fill in the Blanks

questions.question: The term __________ refers to providing services like software and infrastructure over the internet.
questions.hint: Stands for 'Everything as a Service'.

questions.question: IoT systems mainly connect physical devices using __________ and internet technologies.
questions.hint: Devices that detect or measure physical properties.

questions.question: M2M stands for __________ communication.
questions.hint: Direct communication between devices without human intervention.

questions.question: IoT analytics is used to convert data into __________.
questions.hint: The third level of the DIKW pyramid structure.

questions.question: A key IoT design principle is __________, which allows system expansion.
questions.hint: The ability to handle a growing number of devices and data streams.

questions.question: The IoT Reference Architecture includes Functional View, Information View, and __________ View.
questions.hint: Focuses on the physical distribution of components.

questions.question: IoT reference model provides a __________ representation of the system.
questions.hint: An abstract, high-level structural blueprint.

questions.question: The view that focuses on runtime behavior is the __________ view.
questions.hint: Describes how components work together dynamically at runtime.

questions.question: Data visualization in IoT helps in __________ of information.
questions.hint: Transforming complex raw metrics into actionable analytical insights.

questions.question: Interaction and remote control are part of the IoT __________ layer.
questions.hint: The user-facing layer that delivers operational services.

questions.question: 6LoWPAN enables IPv6 over __________ networks.
questions.hint: Optimized networks handling constrained, energy-conscious radio standard packets.

questions.question: IPv6 uses __________-bit addressing.
questions.hint: Provides a vastly expanded space compared to 32-bit schemes.

questions.question: RPL is a routing protocol used in __________ networks.
questions.hint: Networks containing constrained links prone to high packet loss rates (LLNs).

questions.question: Bluetooth Low Energy is designed for __________ consumption.
questions.hint: Engineered for small electronics relying on long-term coin-cell batteries.

questions.question: Zigbee is based on IEEE __________ standard.
questions.hint: The underlying standard defining physical and MAC layer properties for low-rate wireless PANs.

questions.question: __________ is a lightweight messaging protocol widely used in IoT for publish-subscribe communication.
questions.hint: Uses a centralized broker to pass structured updates on named paths/topics.

questions.question: __________ is used for assigning IP addresses automatically to devices in a network.
questions.hint: Dynamically coordinates structural identification blocks across networks.

questions.question: TCP is a __________-oriented protocol.
questions.hint: Requires an established hand-shake sequence to verify data sequencing reliability.

questions.question: CoAP is designed for __________ devices.
questions.hint: Devices running with severe memory, computation, and battery resource footprints.

questions.question: DTLS is used to secure __________-based communication.
questions.hint: Provides transport layer protection over datagram-based execution paths.

questions.question: The __________ layer is responsible for transmitting data between devices over a network.
questions.hint: Handles addressing and packet routing functions across network infrastructures.

questions.question: oneM2M is a __________ layer standard for IoT.
questions.hint: Focuses on middleware layer standardization across different device domains.

questions.question: ETSI M2M focuses on __________-to-machine communication architecture.
questions.hint: Provides structural architecture rules for automated device interactions.

questions.question: 802.15.4 MAC security ensures __________ and integrity of data.
questions.hint: Protects sensitive telemetry assets from unauthorized eavesdropping via frame payload encryption.

questions.question: The application layer provides __________ services to end users.
questions.hint: Delivers context-specific system logic and user interface actions directly to consumers.
